title: OutputNotAFileName payload
description: A `command` step whose `output:` is blank, holds a path separator or a NUL byte, starts with `.`, is a name the run directory already uses for its own records in any ASCII case (map.rs `CommandStep::RESERVED_OUTPUTS`; a darwin release target's file system ignores case), or has the form of a step's log, `<text>-<digits>-<digits>.log` in any ASCII case (drive.rs `run_command` writes `<state>-<index>-<attempt>.log`). The refusal's code is `empty_declaration` for a blank one and `unsupported_construct` otherwise, at `<step>.output` (map.rs `validated_output`).
